title: pyrrosia bonii
intro: Pyrrosia bonii, commonly known as the Chinese tuckahoe fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. The health benefits of Pyrrosia bonii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being.
